    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    while frontier:
        path = frontier.pop(0)
        node = path[-1]
        if node == goal:
            return path
        explored.add(node)
        neighbors = graph.get(node, [])
        frontier.extend((path + [neighbor] for neighbor in neighbors if neighbor not in explored and neighbor not in path))
    return None
